name: Raleigh Police Public Safety Cadets
org: Raleigh Police Department, Youth and Family Services
what_you_do: See what police work is like. You train with officers in a short version of police academy. You also do team building and light fitness, go on field trips, and help at community events and parades.
who_can_apply: Ages 14 to 20. The page lists no other rule.
deadline_text: No dates or deadline are posted. Email the unit to ask how to join.
how_to_apply: Email Eric Hinton at Eric.Hinton@raleighnc.gov or call 984-222-4183.
notes: Cadets meet at the Raleigh Police Youth Services Center. It is at 4205 Spring Forest Rd, Raleigh, NC 27616.
